annotations.title: API health check pack: uptime, latency, headers, x402

description: One call to health-check an API endpoint: up or down with status and response time over three requests (min, median, max), the redirect chain, HTTP security headers, whether it is a paid x402 endpoint and what its payment terms are, and the API's OpenAPI document when one is found at the usual places. Cheaper than the tools bought one by one. Use for API monitoring, before integrating a third-party API, or to check your own after a deploy. Example: url=https://petstore3.swagger.io/api/v3/pet/findByStatus?status=available. Price $0.02/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
